# Symbols Nerd Font: provenance and constituent notices

`SymbolsNerdFont-Regular.ttf` is an unmodified copy of
[Nerd Fonts v3.5.0](https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/tree/bbb2db23a131139161d66a9b526a6fdc79875c92/patched-fonts/NerdFontsSymbolsOnly).
Its Git blob is `55c3a216f87bd106c29d75c1b61586ccca8a39b3`, identical to that
release. The adjacent `LICENSE` is also identical to the release's license.
The font metadata credits Copyright (c) 2016, Ryan McIntyre; the adjacent
MIT license retains Copyright (c) 2014 Ryan L McIntyre. Neither is replaced.

Nerd Fonts assembled this font from the icon sets below. Chibi has not
modified the font. The adjacent MIT license does not replace the constituent
copyright notices or license terms. Preserve this notice, `LICENSE`, and
the `licenses/` directory when redistributing the font. This document does
not certify that existing binary/export packaging includes those files.

Versions below are those recorded by the upstream v3.5.0 Symbols Only README,
unless otherwise indicated.
The full upstream texts are retained, including their original copyright
lines, conditions, and disclaimers; do not infer that every component has
one uniform license from the table's short descriptions.

| Component / attribution | Recorded version | Notice |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Microsoft Codicons | 0.0.45 | [CC BY 4.0](licenses/codicons.txt) |
| Devicons / devicon, konpa and contributors | 2.17.0 | [MIT](licenses/devicons.txt) |
| Hack extra glyphs, Source Foundry Authors / Bitstream Inc. | Hack 3.003 metadata | [MIT and Bitstream Vera notices](licenses/extraglyphs-license.txt) |
| Font Awesome, Fonticons Inc. | 6.5.1 | [Upstream font/icon/code license distinctions](licenses/font-awesome.txt) |
| Font Awesome Extension, André Luiz Gava | 0.0.3 | [MIT](licenses/font-awesome-extension.txt) |
| Font Logos, Lukas W. and contributors | 1.3.0 | [The Unlicense](licenses/font-logos.txt) |
| Material Design, Pictogrammers | Oct 6, 2022 | [Upstream terms](licenses/materialdesign.txt), [Apache 2.0](licenses/apache.txt) |
| Octicons, GitHub Inc. | 18.3.0 | [MIT](licenses/octicons.txt) |
| Seti and original, Jesse Weed | 0.8.1 | [MIT](licenses/seti.txt) |
| Pomicons, Gabriele Lana | 1.001 | [OFL 1.1, Reserved Font Name Pomicons](licenses/pomicons.txt) |
| Powerline Extra, Ryan L McIntyre | 1.200 | [MIT](licenses/powerline-extra.txt) |
| Powerline Symbols, Kim Silkebækken and contributors | 1.000 (ca 2013) | [Permission notice](licenses/powerline-symbols.txt) |
| IEC Power Symbols, Joe Loughry | Feb 2015 | [MIT](licenses/power-iec.txt) |
| Weather Icons, Erik Flowers | 2.0.10 (1.100) | [OFL 1.1](licenses/weather-icons.txt) |

The upstream README's word `unlicensed` for Font Logos refers to **The
Unlicense**, not an absence of permission. The complete v1.3.0 grant is
included. The upstream Weather Icons OFL file contains placeholder fields;
they are retained verbatim rather than inventing copyright dates or names.
The Hack extra-glyph source explicitly retains both Source Foundry and
Bitstream copyright notices, so the complete Hack notice is included rather
than relying on the README's abbreviated MIT label.
